stories.title: Distance Field Contract for Chat Messages
stories.description: Define and enforce a structured frontend contract for provider distance fields (distance_miles:number, distance_text:string) within chat payloads, ensuring compatibility with markdown rendering and preventing schema drift.

stories.title: Distance Formatting Logic
stories.description: Implement client-side logic to normalize and format backend distance values (rounding, unit consistency, '<1 mi' handling, null safety) into a display-ready string aligned with the defined contract.

stories.title: Render Distance in MessageBubble UI
stories.description: Enhance MessageBubble to display formatted distance inline with provider results (near name/address) while preserving markdown rendering, layout integrity, responsiveness, and accessibility (ARIA labels, screen reader clarity).

stories.title: End-to-End Distance Data Integration
stories.description: Integrate backend MAINT-DIST outputs through find_care_facade and tool_router into chat responses, ensuring payloads conform exactly to the frontend distance contract with no transformation gaps.

stories.title: Distance Display Test Coverage
stories.description: Add unit and UI tests validating distance contract compliance, formatting logic, rendering behavior in MessageBubble, and edge cases (missing, null, malformed values).
